newsitem.title: USA: Avesta Technology in partnership with NYNEX.
newsitem.headline: Avesta Technology in partnership with NYNEX.

text.p: Privately-held Avesta Technologies said its partnership with NYNEX Corp will develop Intranet and Extranet applications for the financial services industry.
The first step in the initiative will include Avesta's product Niagara, a subscriber-based JAVA application, the company said.

Niagara delivers customizable real-time information, the company said, adding it is suited for Intranet and Extranet delivery of financial information, news, research and messaging for a closed user group.
Avesta Technologies provides information management services and is not related to the Swedish-British steel company Avesta Sheffield AB.
